notes.title: Patch 1.2.3
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the Player was getting soft locked in Area 5 if they only had 1HP remaining. Hazard removed and have added a health pickup.

notes.title: Patch v1.2.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Checkpoints disabled when player dies to avoid incorrect respawning.
[*] Boss level now redesigned to make it less challenging
[*] Script error amended that was preventing the player from activating the end cut scene.
[/list]

notes.title: HOT FIX: Level 2 (v1.2)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
We've just made an urgent fix to a bug in level 2 that was preventing the player from progressing.

A few other minor tweaks:
- fixed a bug where the Bobbit creature would break by player dashing/boosting towards it
- controller input fixed when first launching the game
- default audio settings fixed so they are now at 100% volume 

Please update and hope you continue diving into the world of Sinew!

Apologies for the inconvenience.

Enjoy!
OddCritter
